meanings.explanation: A [citizen] is a person who belongs to a country and has the right to live and work there.

examples.english: My mom is a [citizen] of China.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈是中国[公民]。

examples.english: All [citizens] can go to school for free.
examples.chinese: 所有[公民]都可以免费上学。

examples.english: I want to be a good [citizen] and help others.
examples.chinese: 我想做一个好[公民]，帮助别人。

meanings.explanation: A [battery] is a small object that stores electricity and is used to make things like toys, remote controls, and flashlights work.

examples.english: My toy car stopped moving because the [battery] is dead.
examples.chinese: 我的玩具车不动了，因为[电池]没电了。

examples.english: Mom put a new [battery] in the clock so it can tell the right time.
examples.chinese: 妈妈给钟表换了新[电池]，这样它就能显示正确时间了。

examples.english: We need to buy some [batteries] for the TV remote control.
examples.chinese: 我们需要给电视遥控器买几节[电池]。

meanings.explanation: If you [come up with] an idea, plan, or answer, you think of it or produce it.

examples.english: She [came up with] a fun game for the party.
examples.chinese: 她为派对[想出]了一个好玩的游戏。

examples.english: Can you [come up with] a good idea for my birthday?
examples.chinese: 你能为我的生日[想出一个]好主意吗？

examples.english: Tom [came up with] the answer to the math problem.
examples.chinese: 汤姆[想出]了这道数学题的答案。

meanings.explanation: To say sorry to someone because you did something wrong or caused a problem. When you [apologize for] something, you tell someone you regret what happened.

examples.english: I want to [apologize for] breaking your toy.
examples.chinese: 我想为弄坏你的玩具[道歉]。

examples.english: She [apologized for] being late to class.
examples.chinese: 她为上课迟到[道了歉]。

examples.english: He should [apologize for] his rude words.
examples.chinese: 他应该为自己无礼的话[道歉]。

meanings.explanation: An [experiment] is something you do to see what happens or to find out if an idea is true.

examples.english: We did a fun [experiment] in science class today.
examples.chinese: 今天科学课上我们做了一个有趣的[实验]。

examples.english: I want to do an [experiment] to see if plants can grow in the dark.
examples.chinese: 我想做一个[实验]，看看植物在黑暗中能不能生长。

examples.english: My brother likes doing [experiments] with baking soda and vinegar.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥喜欢用小苏打和醋做[实验]。

meanings.explanation: If you [carry on] doing something, you continue doing it instead of stopping.

examples.english: Please don't stop, [carry on] singing your song.
examples.chinese: 请别停下，[继续]唱你的歌。

examples.english: Even when it started to rain, we [carried on] playing outside.
examples.chinese: 即使开始下雨了，我们还是[继续]在外面玩。

examples.english: My teacher asked us to [carry on] working while she was gone.
examples.chinese: 老师离开时，让我们[继续]学习。

meanings.explanation: When you [flex] a part of your body, you bend it or tighten a muscle to make it show.

examples.english: Can you [flex] your arm and show me your muscle?
examples.chinese: 你能[弯曲]手臂，让我看看你的肌肉吗？

examples.english: The cat [flexes] its claws when it stretches.
examples.chinese: 猫咪伸懒腰的时候会[张开]爪子。

examples.english: Before running, we should [flex] our knees a few times.
examples.chinese: 跑步前，我们应该[屈]几下膝盖。

meanings.explanation: If you do something [accidentally], you do it by chance and did not mean to do it.

examples.english: I [accidentally] spilled milk on the table.
examples.chinese: 我[不小心]把牛奶洒在了桌子上。

examples.english: She [accidentally] stepped on my foot.
examples.chinese: 她[不小心]踩到了我的脚。

examples.english: Tom [accidentally] left his homework at home.
examples.chinese: 汤姆[不小心]把作业忘在家里了。

meanings.explanation: An [accident] is an unexpected bad event that happens suddenly without anyone intending it.

examples.english: My dad saw a car [accident] on the way to work.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸在上班路上看到了一起汽车[事故]。

examples.english: I knocked over my friend's ice cream by [accident].
examples.chinese: 我[意外]碰掉了朋友的冰淇淋。

examples.english: I had an [accident] on my bike when I turned the corner.
examples.chinese: 我拐弯的时候骑单车出了[意外]。

meanings.explanation: A [descent] is the act of moving downward from a higher place to a lower place.

examples.english: The [descent] down the mountain took us about an hour.
examples.chinese: 花了我们大约一个小时才[下山]。

examples.english: Be careful on the [descent] — the stairs are very slippery.
examples.chinese: [下楼梯]时要小心——台阶很滑。

examples.english: The plane began its [descent] toward the airport.
examples.chinese: 飞机开始向机场[降落]。

meanings.explanation: If something happens [for the time being], it is true now but will probably change later.

examples.english: We can play outside [for the time being], but we have to go home when it gets dark.
examples.chinese: 我们可以在外面[暂时]玩一会儿，但天黑就得回家。

examples.english: [For the time being], I am staying at my grandma's house until our new home is ready.
examples.chinese: [暂时]我住在奶奶家，等新房子准备好了再搬回去。

examples.english: You can borrow my crayons [for the time being], but please give them back after class.
examples.chinese: 你可以[暂时]借我的蜡笔用，但下课要还给我。

meanings.explanation: A [crane] is a very tall machine with a long arm that lifts and moves heavy things at building sites.

examples.english: The workers used a big [crane] to lift the steel beams onto the roof.
examples.chinese: 工人们用一台大[起重机]把钢梁吊到了屋顶上。

examples.english: I saw a yellow [crane] standing next to the new school being built.
examples.chinese: 我看到新建的学校旁边停着一台黄色的[吊车]。

examples.english: The [crane] carefully moved the heavy boxes from the truck to the ground.
examples.chinese: [起重机]小心地把沉重的箱子从卡车上吊到了地上。

meanings.explanation: An [expedition] is an organized journey made for a particular purpose such as exploring or discovery.

examples.english: Our school organized a camping [expedition] to the forest last month.
examples.chinese: 我们学校上个月组织了一次去森林的露营[探险]。

examples.english: Three explorers went on an [expedition] into the deep jungle.
examples.chinese: 三名探险家进入原始丛林开启了他们的[探险]。

examples.english: I went on a little [expedition] in my backyard to find interesting bugs.
examples.chinese: 我在后院开启了一场寻找有趣虫子的小小[探险]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [angry at] someone or something, you feel mad or annoyed because of what they did.

examples.english: Mom was [angry at] me for not cleaning my room.
examples.chinese: 妈妈因为我没打扫房间而[生我的气]。

examples.english: The teacher got [angry at] the boys for running in the hall.
examples.chinese: 老师因为那些男生在走廊里跑而[生他们的气]。

examples.english: My little sister is [angry at] her broken toy.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹因为玩具坏了正在[生气]。

meanings.explanation: If something [terrifies] you, it makes you feel very, very scared.

examples.english: The loud thunder [terrifies] my little dog every time.
examples.chinese: 每次打雷都把我家小狗[吓坏了]。

examples.english: My little brother was [terrified] when he woke up alone in the dark.
examples.chinese: 弟弟一个人在黑暗中醒来时[吓坏了]。

examples.english: The scary movie [terrified] Lisa, so she could not sleep all night.
examples.chinese: 那部恐怖电影把丽莎[吓坏了]，她一晚上都没睡着。

meanings.explanation: A [raft] is a small flat boat made of pieces of wood or other light materials tied together, used for floating on water.

examples.english: We built a small [raft] and floated down the river.
examples.chinese: 我们扎了一个小[竹筏]，顺流而下。

examples.english: The children sat on a [raft] in the swimming pool.
examples.chinese: 孩子们坐在游泳池里的[充气筏]上。

examples.english: The man crossed the lake on a wooden [raft].
examples.chinese: 那个人乘着木[筏子]过了湖。

meanings.explanation: If something [goes wrong], it does not happen in the way you planned or hoped, and it starts to cause problems.

examples.english: When I forgot to add sugar, my cookies [went wrong].
examples.chinese: 我忘了加糖的时候，我的饼干就[做砸了]。

examples.english: We check our game plan before we play, so nothing [goes wrong].
examples.chinese: 我们比赛前先检查计划，这样就不会[出错]。

examples.english: When my bike chain fell off, everything [went wrong] on my way to school.
examples.chinese: 我的自行车链条掉了之后，我上学路上一切都[乱套了]。

meanings.explanation: If you [leave something behind], you do not take it with you when you go somewhere because you forget it or do not need it.

examples.english: I [left behind] my pencil case at home this morning.
examples.chinese: 我今天早上把铅笔盒[落在]家里了。

examples.english: Don't [leave behind] your umbrella when you get off the bus.
examples.chinese: 下公交车时别[落下]你的雨伞。

examples.english: She [left behind] her favorite toy at Grandma's house.
examples.chinese: 她把自己最喜欢的玩具[落在]奶奶家了。

meanings.explanation: If something is [terrifying], it makes you feel extremely frightened or scared.

examples.english: The [terrifying] storm kept us awake all night.
examples.chinese: 那场[可怕的]暴风雨让我们整晚都没睡。

examples.english: The [terrifying] monster in the story gave me goosebumps.
examples.chinese: 故事里那个[吓人的]怪物让我起了一身鸡皮疙瘩。

examples.english: It was [terrifying] to walk through the dark tunnel alone.
examples.chinese: 一个人穿过那条黑暗的隧道真[吓人]。

meanings.explanation: If you do something [on one’s own], you do it without any help from other people.

examples.english: I can tie my shoelaces [on my own] now.
examples.chinese: 我现在可以[独自]系鞋带了。

examples.english: My little sister wants to walk to the park [on her own].
examples.chinese: 我妹妹想[独自]走去公园。

examples.english: Lily finished all her homework [on her own] yesterday.
examples.chinese: 莉莉昨天[独自]做完了所有作业。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [toxic] is poisonous and can make you sick or hurt your health.

examples.english: We should never eat [toxic] mushrooms from the forest.
examples.chinese: 我们绝不能吃森林里的[有毒]蘑菇。

examples.english: The factory stopped dumping [toxic] waste into the river.
examples.chinese: 那家工厂不再往河里倾倒[有毒]垃圾了。

examples.english: Some cleaning products have [toxic] chemicals, so keep them away from kids.
examples.chinese: 有些清洁产品含有[有毒]的化学成分，所以要放在孩子够不到的地方。

meanings.explanation: A [wire] is a long, thin piece of metal used to carry electricity or hold things together.

examples.english: My desk lamp connects to the socket with a long [wire].
examples.chinese: 我的台灯用一根长长的[电线]连在插座上。

examples.english: Dad fixed our broken garden fence with a strong [wire].
examples.chinese: 爸爸用一根结实的[铁丝]修好了我们坏掉的花园围栏。

examples.english: The toy remote car needs a [wire] to charge its battery.
examples.chinese: 这个遥控玩具车需要一根[电线]给电池充电。

meanings.explanation: [Wreckage] is the broken, ruined pieces that are left after something has been destroyed, such as a car, plane, or building.

examples.english: The firefighters carefully searched through the [wreckage] after the accident.
examples.chinese: 事故发生后，消防员仔细地在[残骸]中搜寻。

examples.english: Pieces of [wreckage] from the old ship washed up on the beach.
examples.chinese: 旧船的[残骸]碎片被冲到了海滩上。

examples.english: After the big storm, the [wreckage] of the fallen trees covered the road.
examples.chinese: 大暴风雨过后，倒下的树木[残骸]铺满了道路。

meanings.explanation: A [hook] is a curved piece of metal or plastic that you use for hanging things on or for catching fish.

examples.english: I hung my coat on a [hook] by the door.
examples.chinese: 我把外套挂在门边的[挂钩]上。

examples.english: The fisherman used a [hook] to catch a big fish.
examples.chinese: 渔夫用[鱼钩]钓到了一条大鱼。

examples.english: Be careful! That [hook] is very sharp.
examples.chinese: 小心！那个[钩子]很锋利。

common_collocations: put a shirt on a hanger

meanings.explanation: A [hanger] is a curved piece of wood, metal, or plastic that you use to hang clothes on in a wardrobe or closet.

examples.english: Please put your jacket on a [hanger] in the closet.
examples.chinese: 请把外套挂在衣柜里的[衣架]上。

examples.english: I need to buy more [hangers] for my new shirts.
examples.chinese: 我需要多买几个[衣架]来挂我的新衬衫。

examples.english: Mom asked me to bring the [hangers] back from the laundry room.
examples.chinese: 妈妈让我把洗衣房里的[衣架]拿回来。
